build.privacy: local-only; exported report contains no source text or filesystem paths
build.join: exact v2 text fingerprint plus normalized ingredient identity

full_recipe_view.predicate: bool((title or '').strip()) and any(fragment.strip() for fragment in (steps or '').split('\x1f'))
full_recipe_view.note: All 4653430 canonical rows remain stored; this is a read-only serving predicate.

index_probes.name: total_minutes_at_most_30
index_probes.query_plan: SEARCH recipes USING COVERING INDEX recipes_total_minutes (total_minutes<?)

index_probes.name: servings_equal_4
index_probes.query_plan: SEARCH recipes USING COVERING INDEX recipes_servings (servings=?)

index_probes.name: source_foodcom_522k
index_probes.query_plan: SEARCH recipes USING COVERING INDEX recipes_source (source=?)

coverage_definitions.storage_nonempty: value IS NOT NULL AND value != ''; not SQLite length(value)>0
coverage_definitions.whitespace_only: storage_nonempty and not the corresponding Python-strip predicate
coverage_definitions.notes: Python strip includes Unicode whitespace and U+001F separators. NUL and zero-width space are not whitespace. These counters measure non-whitespace presence, not instruction quality, parsing success, or recipe completeness.

content_coverage_audit.note: Exported coverage uses version 2; immutable database metadata still records legacy raw string presence. Original build fingerprints are historical, not hashes of the revised builder.
content_coverage_audit.nul_note: One leading U+0000 record is retained by Python strip but undercounted by SQLite length. This is not part of the 99 whitespace-only exclusions.

predicates.total_minutes: finite positive source_total; NaN for SQL NULL; no derived sums
predicates.servings: finite positive source_servings; NaN for SQL NULL
predicates.readable: bool((title or '').strip()) and any(fragment.strip() for fragment in (steps or '').split('\x1f')) and text_status != 'unparsed_steps'

performance.benchmark_note: Deterministic 50,000 uniformly sampled unique canonical IDs; 512-ID SQL batches. OS page cache was not evicted; this does not benchmark FTS or full end-to-end search.
